settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Project preferences
settings.retentionDescription: How long this project keeps its compilation outputs and its file history. Something is deleted only when it is both outside the most recent entries and older than the age below: recent work is always kept, whichever value you choose.
settings.retentionOwnerOnly: Only a project owner can change these values.
settings.retentionHintCount: Currently keeping {{effective}}. Leave empty to follow the server default ({{default}}). Allowed: {{min}} to {{max}}.
settings.retentionHintDays: Currently {{effective}} days. Leave empty to follow the server default ({{default}} days). Allowed: {{min}} to {{max}} days.
settings.retentionProtectedHint: The most recent successful compilation and the current revision of every file are never deleted, whatever their age.
settings.fontsDescription: Upload a font to use in compiled documents. Formats: .ttf · .otf · .woff · .woff2
settings.dropFont: Drop a font here or click to browse
settings.fontPreview: The quick brown fox — Laboratory Report — 0123456789
settings.editorDescription: LaTeX source editing and formatting preferences.
settings.autoIndentDescription: Keep the current indentation and automatically indent inside environments when starting a new line.
settings.autosaveDescription: Automatically save changed documents after a period of inactivity. It is disabled by default.
settings.autosaveHint: For a conservative fallback: 300 seconds is 5 minutes, 900 is 15 minutes.
settings.compileDescriptionDefault: Choose where Iris should find compiler binaries. The field is optional: when empty, the backend PATH is used.
settings.compileDescriptionLatex: The project contains .tex sources: choose the LaTeX engine and pipeline to run.
settings.compileDescriptionLilypond: The project contains .ly music sources: Iris will run LilyPond and store the result as a versioned build.
settings.mainFileHint: The file passed to the compiler. When automatic, Iris picks it from the sources.
settings.mainFileAutoHint: Iris is currently compiling {{path}}. Choose a file to fix it for the whole project.
settings.mainFileAutoEmptyHint: No source file to compile yet.
settings.mainFileSetHint: Every compilation of this project starts from this file, whichever one is open.
settings.mainFileStaleHint: The selected file no longer exists: Iris falls back to detection until you choose another one.
settings.pathHintUnlocked: When empty, the backend PATH is used; alternatively enter the folder containing {{executable}}.
settings.pathHintLocked: Configured by the Docker Compose deployment; edit the mapping in docker-compose.yml.
settings.lilypondArgsHint: Inserted between lilypond and the .ly file; quoted values are supported. Iris still manages the destination.
settings.formatSvg: SVG — one vector image per page
settings.formatHint: PNG, SVG and scores with multiple blocks can produce several files in one versioned build.
settings.outputOverwriteHint: Each compilation creates an immutable versioned build available from Compilation history.
settings.noCustomFonts: No custom fonts. System fonts remain available.
